title: Number Watch #1: headline numbers
document: Nonfarm payrolls increased by a seasonally adjusted 165,000 for the month, compared with the Dow Jones estimate for 59,000, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Friday. The unemployment rate nudged down to 4.1%, compared with the forecast for 4.2%. The labor force had been shrinking, the result of demographic changes and immigration reductions, but expanded by 421,000 in October.
